notes.title: Combat and Tutorials
notes.content:
New update live, this update adds the basic combat system, though one sided at the moment.

Additions and fixes:
fixed the walking animation for the boy, you no longer slide around for a bit.
you can now hit things with the sword
a tutorial level has been added, it is still in development but the main parts are there.


Known bugs:
While blocking you slide to the left if you are moving or have just stopped moving while holding right click.
No enemies have been added yet nor any traps or other hazards.
The fox will not pass through the spaces where a door has been if called

Future plans:
Still no word on how the sound is going so it may be a while away still, ill look into adding some free SFX in the meantime though music might not be added till closer to full-release.

Will add in will-o-wisps to show paths around the maps to secrets, they will only be visible to the fox thus making him more useful.

Still working on the designs for the first boss and the smaller mobs that you can battle throughout the levels.

Thank you to all those who have played or purchased the game thus far and comments or anything you think should be added or fixed would be appreciated
